sources.name: OpenTelemetry Go
sources.use: trace and metric API plus SDK verification

adapter_decisions.producer_send_span_kind_reason: The completion observation does not prove a broker send attempt or expose the creation context required by a standard send span.
adapter_decisions.poll_receive_span_kind_reason: The root poll observation includes handler and settlement work rather than receive-only timing and status.
adapter_decisions.consumer_process_span_kind_reason: Record and batch observations can occur before a handler starts, and failed observations do not distinguish pre-handler rejection from handler failure.
adapter_decisions.metric_identity_policy: Adapter metrics are identity-free; pinned standard metrics use only allowlisted topic and consumer-group dimensions from their schemas.
adapter_decisions.provider_boundary: Provider panics are contained and redacted; deadline enforcement requires cancellation-cooperative in-process providers.
